8. **Structured press.** The second press mode, with templates for every king and script envoys, as under "Two press modes"; and the clauses every letter carries in full press too, so a script reads any letter by its formulas, whoever wrote the words. Also "Recognition is earned" under The world: rank as starting data, the record of who calls whom brother and grants whom the title, a new claim becoming established in play, and the general script rule that replaces Babylonia's named rule against Assyria, with the opening positions telling model kings the same facts. Also characters as agents in local play: local play ("Local play on a Claude subscription" under Tech stack) runs only the kings as agents, so its characters are script, which under structured press would force its model kings onto templates. Make local play able to run the characters as agents too, chosen at setup like every other model, using the simulation kit's file characters. With characters as agents, they sleep as kings do ("Characters sleep like kings"): measure wake-ups per character and calls per season, from which item 18 sets the pool's default size ("How many characters").
